dedupe_keys.name: airline on time performance data bts transtats

description: The Airline On-Time Performance database holds the scheduled and actual departure and arrival times of individual domestic non-stop flights reported monthly to the Bureau of Transportation Statistics by US certificated air carriers that account for at least half of one percent of domestic scheduled passenger revenues (one percent before 2018). The Reporting Carrier table runs from 1987 to 2026 and a Marketing Carrier table, which groups regional code-share partners under their marketing airline, from January 2018. Each flight record gives carrier, origin and destination airports, scheduled and actual gate times, taxi-out and taxi-in times, air time, non-stop distance, cancelled and diverted flights, and causes of delay and cancellation. Data are downloadable free from TranStats as CSV by month with field selection, with summary tables and definitions; as US government statistics they are unrestricted, and copies circulate in research repositories (monthly Form 234 files on the National Transportation Library, aggregated copies on figshare). Caveats: only the largest carriers and domestic flights are covered, the reporting threshold changed in 2018, and carrier codes change over time, for which TranStats provides stable carrier identifiers. The data support airport and airspace capacity, delay propagation and resilience analyses of the national air network, and complement the T-100 traffic statistics.
